藏品名称_EN: Brocade with bird and animal motifs, lot 128, miscellaneous, no. 43, of which 3
藏品名称_ZN: 鳥獣連珠文錦　第128号櫃 雑第43号 其３
描述_EN: A fragment of sutra brocade of unknown purpose. The central design is a diamond-shaped floral motif surrounded by two interlocking beaded circles. Within the beaded circles are symmetrically woven birds and animals. The weaving technique of this piece dates back to the Han Dynasty of China and has an ancient style.
描述_ZN: 用途不明的经幡织锦碎片。 中心图案是一个菱形的花卉图案，周围有两种交错的珠圈。 珠圈内是对称编织的鸟类和动物。 这件作品的编织技术可以追溯到中国的汉代，具有古老的风格。
